stories.title: Hackers Pose as Domain Controllers to Steal Active Directory Password Hashes
stories.description: Attackers abuse Active Directory replication in DCSync attacks to impersonate domain controllers and steal privileged password hashes.

stories.title: CISA Warns of Fortinet Heap-based Buffer Overflow Flaw Exploited in Attacks
stories.description: CISA added critical Fortinet vulnerability CVE-2025-25249 to its KEV catalog after confirming active exploitation.

stories.title: OpenSSL 4.1.0 Alpha1 Released With DTLS 1.3 and Faster Post-Quantum Cryptography
stories.description: OpenSSL has released 4.1.0 Alpha1, introducing DTLS 1.3, GREASE support, and performance improvements for post-quantum cryptography.

stories.title: 4.1 Million Impacted by AdaptHealth Data Breach
stories.description: In June 2026, hackers stole personal, health, and insurance information from AdaptHealth’s systems.

stories.title: Palo Alto PAN-OS Vulnerability Enables Arbitrary Code Execution as Root User
stories.description: Palo Alto Networks disclosed a high-severity PAN-OS flaw enabling unauthenticated remote code execution with root privileges on affected PA-Series firewalls.

stories.title: CISA Flags Exploited Cisco, Citrix, Fortinet Flaws, Sets Sept. 12 Federal Patch Deadline
stories.description: CISA adds three exploited Cisco, Citrix, and Fortinet flaws to KEV, requiring federal agencies to patch by September 12, 2026.

stories.title: Organizations Warned of Cisco Secure FMC Exploitation
stories.description: Cisco and CISA have flagged exploitation of CVE-2026-20079, a vulnerability disclosed in March 2026.

stories.title: Nearly 1 in 10 Exposed LiteLLM Gateways Accepted the Example "sk-1234" Admin Key
stories.description: Wiz found 294 of 3,074 LiteLLM gateways accepted sk-1234, exposing provider keys and enabling cloud IAM access in tests.

stories.title: New ‘ShieldCrash’ Zero-Day Exploit Targets Microsoft Defender
stories.description: The exploit provides full System privileges on Windows machines running the September 2026 patches.

stories.title: Anthropic Discloses Fourth AI Hacking Incident Involving Claude Opus 4.6
stories.description: Anthropic says four Claude incidents breached real third-party systems during misconfigured cybersecurity evaluations.

stories.title: Fortinet Code Execution Flaw Exploited in PivotC2 RAT Attacks
stories.description: The high-severity, unauthenticated vulnerability tracked as CVE-2025-25249 was patched in January 2026.

stories.title: U.S. Disrupts Xinbi Guarantee Scam Marketplace, Freezes $52.8 Million in Crypto
stories.description: U.S. authorities disrupted Xinbi Guarantee and froze $52.8 million in crypto tied to the scam marketplace and its merchant network.

stories.title: Scans for Proxmox Servers, (Wed, Sep 9th)
stories.description: About a week ago, Proxmox published an advisory revealing a vulnerability in older versions of Proxmox VE, its flagship Virtual Environment product. The vulnerability only affects version 7, which has not been supported for a couple of years now.
